scope: Conditional normal ordered-access/call/result projection for new write and timer; not full register ABI or a new image.
normal_premises: All code, private frame, pointers, fresh byte/word and MMIO accesses complete normally.
Original 32-byte and new 16-byte frames valid/aligned; no adverse source/destination/MMIO/frame aliases or intervening writes; private frame residue is not observed.
All original and native polls eventually observe the required bit; no timeout is added.
Live GP denotes the same readable scale byte; no asynchronous code/register changes or observers.
Actual relocation targets remain the reviewed genuine C definitions; no substitution or unproved external provider.

write.native_source_held_in: S0, with incoming S0 restored from entrySP-8
write.native_destination_held_in: S1, with incoming S1 restored from entrySP-12
write.original_program_entry_A2: Fresh saved source; callee ignores it before own count256. New typed two-argument call does not claim that physical entry value.
write.new_private_frame_word: Incoming S1 saved at entrySP-12; original source slot entrySP-20 is not reproduced.
fault_prefix_differences: Different frame extent, saved words and source retention; original fresh SP+12 reload after erase absent in C.
New A0 zeroed before RA/S0/S1 restores; original restores RA/S0 before zeroing A0.

timer.normal_A0: Original input, untouched by native machine code.

native_normal_registers.A3_A4_A5: Unwritten by native timer; retain incoming values.

missing_declarations: unlock actual A1 write missing in ASM clobber list
erase actual A1 write missing in ASM clobber list
unused_quarter.bounded_actual_machine_observation: Incoming source saved at SP+12 before calls and reloaded after erase; no encoded A1 use between these calls and the reload. Destination in preserved S1, CSR mask in preserved S0.
